fields.name: summary
fields.label: Summary
fields.description: One-sentence description shown on project cards.

fields.name: alt
fields.label: Cover Alt Text
fields.description: Describe the image for screen readers (required for accessibility).

fields.name: alt
fields.label: Gallery item Alt Text
fields.description: Describe the image for screen readers (required for accessibility).

fields.name: kind
fields.label: Kind
fields.description: Shown on the project page: render → Board renders, dashboard → Outcome. Other kinds are kept but not displayed.

fields.name: models
fields.label: 3D models
fields.description: Interactive 3D boards (GLB converted from the STEP file), one per board.

fields.name: specs
fields.label: Key specs
fields.description: Shown in the project header, e.g. MCU / ESP32-WROOM-32E.

fields.name: tags
fields.label: Tags
fields.description: Free text array. e.g. 'ESP32', 'PCB Design', 'MQTT'. Add any new tag without a code or schema change.

fields.name: role
fields.label: Your Role
fields.description: e.g. 'Hardware & Firmware Engineer'

fields.name: github
fields.label: GitHub URL
fields.description: Not shown on the project page (the repositories are private).

fields.name: order
fields.label: Homepage Order
fields.description: Lower number = shown first. Only applies if Featured = true.

fields.name: draft
fields.label: Draft (hide from site)
fields.description: When true, this project is excluded from all public pages. Set to false when ready to publish.

fields.name: body
fields.label: Write-up
fields.description: Full project write-up in MDX. Sections: Objective → Key Components → Features → Hardware Design (optional) → Outcome.

fields.name: alt
fields.label: Avatar Alt Text
fields.description: Describe the image for screen readers (required for accessibility).

fields.name: resume
fields.label: Resume PDF
fields.description: Upload the current CV as a PDF. Path stored as public/resume/…

fields.name: stats
fields.label: Hero stats
fields.description: Up to 4 proof numbers shown under your name on the home page, e.g. 6 / boards designed. Leave empty to hide the row. Use real numbers only.

fields.name: about
fields.label: About me (home page)
fields.description: Up to 6 short cards on the home page, e.g. Currently learning / Embedded systems, ROS and IoT protocols.

fields.name: tools
fields.label: Tools & platforms
fields.description: Shown as chips under Skills on the home page (no skill level).

fields.name: endDate
fields.label: End Date
fields.description: Leave blank if current = true.

fields.name: tags
fields.label: Tags / Technologies
fields.description: Free-text tags. Add any new technology without changing the schema.

fields.name: category
fields.label: Category
fields.description: Free text, lowercase. e.g. 'programming', 'protocols', 'iot & communication'. The UI groups by whatever categories exist — no code change needed for a new category.

fields.name: proficiency
fields.label: Proficiency (1–5)
fields.description: Optional. 1 = beginner, 5 = expert.
